title: The Ultimate FullBody
author: maximus B.
desc:
The purpose of this program is to allow someone to go to the gym 2x a week while still being able to grow.

You either run this program on Mon Thursday or Tuesday Saturday, while doing conditioning work on the days after the lifting days
